verdict.rationale: Jules documents a public API that covers core task workflows: creating automated workflows, sending messages to the agent, approving plans, and optionally auto-creating PRs. A community user confirms dispatching tasks via the API. However, API keys must be created in the web app's Settings page, and nothing shows UI-to-API parity for settings, repository access, diff review or PR management. missing for 10: evidence of full UI/API parity (settings, repo connection, diff browsing, notifications), programmatic API key management, a published API spec (OpenAPI probes returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
